title: random fih mod
description: the fih Tango, Parka and Samba from doctor4ts pond
body:
This mod adds Parka, Tango and Samba as mobs, and items for each of them having unique abilities!
the Samba item is the strongest of all three, being able to summon a samba and dealing a whopping 100k damage
the Tango item is a bartering item for piglins and will have a second ability later on
the Parka item mines like alot

Item Textures are by Nebular ![all three fih in blockbench](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59d909de48976a2ceb84e2334e7b5438f75066ae.png)
Models, Animations and Model Textures are by Drift
